sample_unit: screening mammography examinations (26,694 FFDM and 3,183 DBT)

links.outcome: AI detection of false negative cancers on local retrospective screening mammograms against 1-year follow-up ground truth
links.effect: AI detected 7/13 (54%) false negative cancers in the FFDM cohort and 4/10 (40%) in the DBT cohort missed by the radiologist; median detection 272 and 248 days sooner.
links.quote: Artificial intelligence was able to detect 7/13 false negative cancers (54%) in the FFDM cohort and 4/10 (40%) in the DBT cohort on the preceding screening mammogram that was interpreted as negative by the radiologist.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation study of a commercially available AI tool to detect false-negative breast cancers on screening mammograms; evaluates model diagnostic performance without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
